frame: X forward along barrel; Y transverse; Z toward housing knobs; front housing face X=0; symmetry Y=0

cad_proxy.purpose: Idealized editable layout; detailed STL is the contact reference.

copper_nozzle.reference: photo-measurements.json; adjacent scanned sleeve for local scale

umbilical_boot.basis: Grip-sized initial section reported by the operator; cuff/shoulder/neck shape in supplied photos. The far cut is a modeling boundary.

trigger.basis: Photo silhouette; front grip face is not directly scanned.

wire_feed.hidden_hollows: Inferred; external scan distances are in validation.json.

allowance_scope: Rough modeling allowances describe uncertain photo-derived geometry. They are not statistical confidence intervals, scanner tolerances, print clearances or physical qualification.
